item.title: Massive AI layoffs are happening, but is that the real reason? - Switzer
item.description: Recent layoff narratives tell the story that AI is making human labour replaceable, and responsible management demands adjustment. The evidence, however, tells a more nuanced story.

item.title: How does your super balance compare with other people your age? - Switzer
